entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Alright, you be careful on your way home.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Don't stick around Shinjuku too long after[n]dark, honey. We get a lot of shady types[n]coming out of the woodwork.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Honestly. That lady's going to be the[n]death of me...

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You'd better head home. If she catches[n]you, you're in for an all-nighter.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Oh, that's adorable. Feels like gratitude's[n]hard to come by, these days.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Hee hee... You're gonna be a real[n]heartbreaker in a few years.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: ...Oh, I'm just teasing you. Now go on[n]home before some degenerate in a[n]gutter spits on you or something.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Careful now... If you play with fire,[n]you'll get burned.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Well, at the very least, Ichiko-chan's[n]probably going to drink until sunrise.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: And since she's in such a good mood,[n]she'd probably make you stick around[n]until she's done.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Well, I'd better get back inside.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: You'll always be welcome here. But[n]head straight home tonight, okay?
